correctness.rationale: Prime-order difference makes every four-cycle minor nonzero; leaf elimination proves Kruskal rank at least five, a K2,3 forces weight six, and nonproportional root-of-unity columns force row rank r+s. Over fields q<=6 distinct nonzero row ratios cannot number six; over F7, three permutation products give 1=-1 contradiction. The packaged exact GF8 verifier exhaustively evaluates all 443703 subsets of sizes 1 to 5 and a six-edge dependent witness, and checks 720 normalized GF7 permutation candidates; this tests the concrete instance, not the infinite proof.
